The finding’s claim about “not registered as deleted” and “orphaned settings … if the migration’s delete fails or is skipped” is speculative and refers to behavior/mechanisms not shown in the diff; nothing in the diff demonstrates a required “deleted settings registry” or a concrete resulting defect.
